defmodule TenantStorage do
  @moduledoc """
  Multi-tenant file storage with isolation guarantees.
  Each tenant gets a sandboxed directory under /var/tenants/<tenant_id>/
  """

  @base_path "/var/tenants"

  defmodule PathValidator do
    @doc "Validates that a resolved path stays within tenant boundary"
    def validate_tenant_path(resolved_path, tenant_id) do
      expected_prefix = Path.join("/var/tenants", tenant_id)
      String.starts_with?(resolved_path, expected_prefix <> "/") or
        resolved_path == expected_prefix
    end
  end

  defmodule SymlinkGuard do
    @doc "Checks path components for symlinks before access"
    def check_path_components(path) do
      components = Path.split(path)
      check_components_recursive(components, "")
    end

    defp check_components_recursive([], _acc), do: :ok
    defp check_components_recursive([component | rest], acc) do
      current = Path.join(acc, component)
      case File.lstat(current) do
        {:ok, %File.Stat{type: :symlink}} ->
          {:error, :symlink_detected}
        {:ok, _} ->
          check_components_recursive(rest, current)
        {:error, :enoent} ->
          # Path doesn't exist yet, that's fine for creation
          :ok
      end
    end
  end

  def read_file(tenant_id, relative_path) do
    with :ok <- validate_tenant_id(tenant_id),
         :ok <- validate_relative_path(relative_path),
         full_path <- build_path(tenant_id, relative_path),
         :ok <- SymlinkGuard.check_path_components(full_path),
         resolved <- resolve_and_validate(full_path, tenant_id) do
      resolved
    end
  end

  def write_file(tenant_id, relative_path, content) do
    with :ok <- validate_tenant_id(tenant_id),
         :ok <- validate_relative_path(relative_path),
         full_path <- build_path(tenant_id, relative_path),
         :ok <- SymlinkGuard.check_path_components(full_path),
         :ok <- ensure_directory(full_path, tenant_id),
         :ok <- safe_write(full_path, content, tenant_id) do
      {:ok, full_path}
    end
  end

  defp validate_tenant_id(tenant_id) do
    if Regex.match?(~r/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/, tenant_id) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_tenant_id}
    end
  end

  defp validate_relative_path(path) do
    cond do
      String.contains?(path, "..") -> {:error, :path_traversal}
      String.starts_with?(path, "/") -> {:error, :absolute_path}
      String.contains?(path, "\0") -> {:error, :null_byte}
      true -> :ok
    end
  end

  defp build_path(tenant_id, relative_path) do
    Path.join([@base_path, tenant_id, relative_path])
  end

  defp resolve_and_validate(full_path, tenant_id) do
    # Resolve the real path to catch any symlink tricks
    case resolve_real_path(full_path) do
      {:ok, real_path} ->
        if PathValidator.validate_tenant_path(real_path, tenant_id) do
          File.read(real_path)
        else
          {:error, :path_escape}
        end
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_real_path(path) do
    # Use realpath to resolve symlinks - canonical mode requires existence
    case System.cmd("realpath", [path], stderr_to_stdout: true) do
      {result, 0} -> {:ok, String.trim(result)}
      {_, _} -> {:error, :resolve_failed}
    end
  end

  defp ensure_directory(full_path, tenant_id) do
    dir = Path.dirname(full_path)
    # Check the directory doesn't escape tenant boundary
    case resolve_real_path(dir) do
      {:ok, real_dir} ->
        if PathValidator.validate_tenant_path(real_dir, tenant_id) do
          File.mkdir_p(dir)
        else
          {:error, :directory_escape}
        end
      {:error, _} ->
        {:error, :directory_not_found}
    end
  end

  defp safe_write(full_path, content, tenant_id) do
    # Atomically resolve and write to the real path, not the logical path
    case resolve_real_path(full_path) do
      {:ok, real_path} ->
        if PathValidator.validate_tenant_path(real_path, tenant_id) do
          File.write(real_path, content)
        else
          {:error, :write_escape}
        end
      {:error, :resolve_failed} ->
        # For new files, resolve parent and write using resolved parent + basename
        parent = Path.dirname(full_path)
        case resolve_real_path(parent) do
          {:ok, real_parent} ->
            if PathValidator.validate_tenant_path(real_parent, tenant_id) do
              real_target = Path.join(real_parent, Path.basename(full_path))
              File.write(real_target, content)
            else
              {:error, :write_escape}
            end
          {:error, _} ->
            {:error, :parent_not_found}
        end
    end
  end
end
